title: The Crimson Hexagon: the name, its chronology and how it asks to be read
description: These claims date the name Crimson Hexagon from the premonition dream, the 2014 Pearl volume in the Crimson Hexagon Series and the 2015 Mind Control Poems post, and set it apart from the Harvard analytics company of 2007 and the unattributed "Crimson Hexagon Embassy" of 2026. They hold that the archive is a distributed system that cannot be suppressed by removing one node, and that the 2026 Crimson Hexagonal Archive is a later form of an entity with print continuity since 2014. Forecasts and unbuilt tests from the primers and navigation maps predict how summarizers will read the Hexagon, address it to future compilers, and specify architecture-aware traversal checks.
